Emerald-outlined search field with Clear. Chips are at least 48pt tall and scroll horizontally without clipping. Mist note: search reads saved records only and never changes them. (1) Home: field; with an empty query, the existing helper text. Proposed: a category grid of the owner-listed kinds (Transactions, Categories, Accounts, Members, Capital, Payments, Loans, Reminders, Reconciliations, Period history), each with a count from persisted records, and recent searches with Clear. (2) Results: existing aggregate line 'N matching records' and result rows. Each row is an accessible button whose label names the record kind, title and destination. Rows show title, kind, date and amount, with outflows in red and a minus sign. Proposed: sections grouped by kind with per-kind counts and View all, and type chips that filter the list. (3) Filters, proposed: full-screen list of filter rows (record type, date range, amount min/max, account, member, category, status) with 'Clear all' and 'Apply filters' (no live count unless authorized). Focus is trapped and returns to the Filters chip, which shows the active count. (4) Details: today a result opens its section. Proposed: open the specific existing record screen (transactions open TX-03 with description, role badge, signed amount, date, category, account, split lines with a total check, related reversal/replacement links shown as date, description and amount, and 'Reverse and replace' only if the owner decides it appears here). The back link reads 'Results for <query>'. Proposed: returning restores query, filters, chip selection and scroll. Corrections only through the existing reversal flow. (5) No results: existing empty message 'No matching records in this LLC.' Proposed additions: name the active filters, an illustration slot, suggestions, 'Clear filters' and 'Edit search'. All counts and amounts in the proposal are synthetic.
